fundamental.summary: ORCL shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, and earnings in 14 days creating elevated event risk.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (251.5) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings binary event in 14 days compounds volatility risk for ORCL.
